content.text:
All five masked sections are reconstructed, the project builds, and every contract behavior was verified live against the running service.

## What was restored

**`SiteInfoService.java`** (3 methods, using the retained `siteToFullMap`/`siteToListMap` helpers):
- `addSite` — looks up the order first (404 `"订单不存在"` if absent, nothing persisted), inserts the `SiteInfo` via `SiteInfoMapper` (generated key flows back onto the entity through `useGeneratedKeys`), transitions the order to `"REVIEWING"` only when its loaded status was `"PENDING"`, and returns `success("添加成功", fullMap)`.
- `listSites` — order lookup gates the read; returns `ApiResponse.success(list)` (message `"success"`) with summary maps that omit `responsiblePersonIdCard`/`responsiblePersonEmail`; empty array when the order has no sites.
- `getSiteDetail` — 404 `"网站信息不存在"` when missing, otherwise `success(fullMap)`.

**`FilingOrderService.java`** (2 methods):
- `getOrderDetail` — 404 `"订单不存在"` when missing, otherwise `success(orderToMap(order))`.
- `getProgress` — 404 when missing, otherwise a payload with `orderId`/`orderNo`/`domainName`/`status` plus the fixed four-step checklist: `提交申请` always true, `初审` true unless `PENDING`, `管局审核` and `备案完成` true exactly when `APPROVED` (via a small private `progressStep` helper).

## Verification

- `mvn package -DskipTests` from `/workspace` compiles cleanly and produces `target/platform-1.0.0.jar`.
- Ran the jar on port 8080 against MySQL and exercised every route: order detail, progress at `PENDING`/`REVIEWING`/`APPROVED` (step flags matched the contract in each state), site add (generated `id` returned, `PENDING → REVIEWING` transition observed, second add left `REVIEWING` untouched), site list (summary shape, empty array case), site detail, and all five 404 paths returning the exact Chinese messages with HTTP 404.
- No `<MASKED>` placeholders remain; only the two listed files were modified; the test server was stopped and temp files removed.
